lines.l: Tell me that I'll be fine
I feel like you knew me, it's like in the movies
You came out of nowhere, saved my life
You are the ocean, I'll be the droplet
Falling from heaven into your arms
I'm here ready to adore you
I'll be waiting like I told you
I'm here ready to adore you
I'll be waiting like I told you.
I'm here ready to adore you.
I'll be waiting like I told ya
Hold me closer, I already adore ya, right here, baby, I'll be waiting.
If the world ends tonight, you'll be in my arms.
You'll be frozen in time. Underneath the stars, my lungs are screaming.
